2527-3845-4076-4279-4549.easyPrerequisites:
You control another nontoken Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, Wizard or Orc that has toughness 2 or more.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2527-3845-4076-4279-4549.description:
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Burakos, adding one mana of any color.
Burakos triggers, causing it and other creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and undying until end of turn.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the other Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, Wizard or Orc, targeting Burakos
When the creature dies, the creature's undying ability and Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Burakos and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing Burakos, targeting the other creature.
When Burakos dies, its undying ability and Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning Burakos from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the other creature and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1479-2783-2841-8101.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Wooded Foothills.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2783-2841-8101.description:
Fetch a land using Wooded Foothills.
When the fetched land enters, Nesting Dragon and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Nesting Dragon trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Nesting Dragon from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Nesting Dragon triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

586-728-1739-5258-5618.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

549-2034-6871--183.manaNeeded: {0} plus the cost of the creature that earthbends
549-2034-6871--183.description:
Cast the earthbending creature by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, you lose 1 life and create a 2/2 artifact creature token.
The earthbending creature enters as an artifact land creature due to Biotransference and Toph.
When that creature enters, it earthbends, causing itself to become a land creature with haste, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on itself, and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing that creature, adding {C}{C}.
When that creature dies, the delayed ability from step 4 triggers, causing it to return to the battlefield tapped as an artifact land creature.
Repeat from step 3 any number of times.

1491-2113-6218-7741.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

186-2060-5140-7704.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
186-2060-5140-7704.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4314-6972-7379.description:
Activate Zack by paying {1} and sacrificing it.
When Zack dies, its persist ability and Pawn of Ulamog triggers.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Zack from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the Zack ability from step 1.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4659-6972-7156.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Arcbound Hybrid.
When Arcbound Hybrid dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Hybrid's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Hybrid from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Repeat.

3459-5078-6006-6918.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

1170-3363-3536-5078.description:
Declare Cheering Fanatic as an attacker. When it triggers, choose to name "Sensei's Divining Top".
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking The One Ring.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate The One Ring by tapping it, putting a burden counter on it and causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Repeat from step 2

575-2092-5971-7097.notablePrerequisites: ZImone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
575-2092-5971-7097.description:
Activate Yavimaya Elder by paying {1} and sacrificing it.
When Yavimaya Elder dies, it and Yedora trigger.
Resolve the Yavimaya Elder trigger, allowing you to search your library for up to two basic land cards and put them into your hand.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, returning Yavimaya Elder from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Yavimaya Elder enters, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate Yavimaya Elder by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning Yavimaya Elder face-up.
Resolve the Yavimaya Elder ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Avatar Kuruk

2334-6913-7009.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn
2334-6913-7009.description:
Activate Chameleon using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Soulherder triggers, blinking Chameleon. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn.

2173-4740-5220-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional nontoken creature.
2173-4740-5220-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying X life, where X is the creature's mana value.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Repeat.
2173-4740-5220-5256.notes: Your starting life total will need to be at least a certain number depending on the mana value of the creature you are sacrificing to perform this combo. This list shows the minimum life total you would need to have, from mana value 1 (left) to 10 (right): 2, 4, 7, 11, 16, 22, 29, 37, 46, 56. You can also cast spells to reduce the needed life to start.

2232-3821-5686-6843.easyPrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
2232-3821-5686-6843.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
Cast Anti-Venom by paying {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
When Anti-Venom enters, its first ability and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Anti-Venom trigger, returning Peregrine Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Peregrine Drake enters, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Anti-Venom from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Peregrine Drake.
Repeat.

955-6575-6684.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of The First Tyrannic War and then putting two lore counters on it.
The First Tyrannic War token's first, second and third chapter abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger. Then, resolve the second trigger, putting a lore counter on Esper Terra.
Esper Terra's second chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of a nonlegendary enchantment you control.
Resolve the third First Tyrannic War trigger, putting two lore counters on Esper Terra and causing you to sacrifice the First Tyrannic War token.
Esper Terra's third and fourth chapter abilities trigger. Resolve the third ability's trigger, creating a token copy of a nonlegendary enchantment you control.
Resolve the fourth trigger, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2933-4499-5295-5798.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Scions by tapping them, adding {2}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tapped Eldrazi Scion tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite {C}, and then forego tapping or sacrificing subsequent Eldrazi Scions.

245-1069-5499-6633.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
245-1069-5499-6633.description:
Activate Marneus Calgar by paying {6}, creating two 2/2 Astartes Warrior creature tokens.
When the Astartes Warriors enter the battlefield, Marneus Calgar triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to an Astartes Warrior.
Activate the Astartes Warrior with Lotus Ring attached by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining Astartes Warrior.
Repeat from step 1.

224-1772-3257-3875.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it, Retreat to Coralhelm and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2128-4697-6477.description:
Cast Reality Spasm by paying a total of {U}{U} due to Hinata, targeting every permanent on the battlefield or a number of permanents equal to your deck size, whichever is smaller.
Voracious Bibliophile triggers, causing you to draw a card for each permanent targeted.

3212-5256-6481.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing God-Eternal Kefnet.
When God-Eternal Kefnet dies, it triggers, putting itself into your library third from the top.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill cards equal to God-Eternal Kefnet's power, ultimately milling God-Eternal Kefnet.
Colossal Grave-Reaver's second ability triggers, putting God-Eternal Kefnet from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

488-1482-2478-4986-5754.notablePrerequisites: One of either Jeweled Lotus or Mishra's Bauble must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
488-1482-2478-4986-5754.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Phlage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Phlage enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities and Loran trigger.
Resolve the first Phlage trigger, sacrificing it.
Resolve the second Phlage trigger, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to gain 3 life.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning the other {0} cost artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Activate the {0} cost artifact by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

222-527-647-5231.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {B}{G}{G}.
Activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

225-565-1018-1987.notablePrerequisites:
You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {U}.
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-565-1018-1987.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, targeting Skullwinder and the mana-producing land.
Orvar triggers, creating a copy of the mana-producing land.
When the land token enters the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers.
Holding priority, activate the nontoken land by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the land.
Activate the nontoken land by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger from step 3, untapping it.
Resolve Ghostly Flicker, blinking the land and Skullwinder.
When the land and Skullwinder enter the battlefield, Skullwinder and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Skullwinder trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate the land token by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the land token.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger from step 8, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.
225-565-1018-1987.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may cast Ghostly Flicker targeting any other permanent(s).

372-864-2955.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Justiciar's Portal exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Eternal Witness exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Justiciar's Portal.
372-864-2955.description:
Cast Justiciar's Portal by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Eternal Witness and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Eternal Witness trigger.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Justiciar's Portal from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Justiciar's Portal.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Eternal Witness and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1309-2061-4377.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Walk the Aeons each turn.
1309-2061-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Salvager of Secrets.
When the Salvager of Secrets token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

7-708-1669-2500-2931.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures with a +1/+1 counter on them.
7-708-1669-2500-2931.description:
Activate Mirage Mirror by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Myth Unbound until end of turn.
Cast Faceless One from the command zone by paying {0}.
Activate Thaumatog's second ability by sacrificing Faceless One.
Choose to return Faceless One to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the ability from step 3.
Repeat from step 2.

1972-2736-4691.description:
Activate Zedruu by paying {U}{R}{W}, giving control of Vilis to an opponent.
During that opponent's draw step, they draw a card.
Nekusar triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Vilis triggers, causing the opponent to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3 until the opponent loses the game either due to drawing from an empty library, or from having 0 life.

637-997-5173-5220.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it, Mortuary and Archghoul of Thraben trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Shambling Ghast on top of your library.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Archghoul of Thraben trigger, revealing Shambling Ghast from the top of your library and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Shambling Ghast by paying {B}.
Repeat.

3169-4659-5003.notablePrerequisites:
Genesis Chamber is untapped.
You control at least one nontoken artifact creature.
3169-4659-5003.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing any nontoken artifact creature, adding {C}{C}.
The creature dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
The creature enters the battlefield, triggering Genesis Chamber, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Myr, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

1978-3301-4131.description:
Animate Basalt Monolith using Tezzeret, Betrayer of Flesh.
Activate Basalt Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Basalt Monolith.
Repeat from step 2.

1261-4620.notablePrerequisites: Captain of the Mists does not have summoning sickness.
1261-4620.description:
Activate Captain of the Mists by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, untap Time Vault.
Activate Time Vault by tapping it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
